concerns.text: FR-001 mandates storing the Möbius result as a ternary array 'using 2-bit encoding'. The plan (Task 1.1) and data-model specify `int8` dtype (~10 MB) with no 2-bit packing step or any task addressing the encoding requirement. Either the plan must add a packing task or the spec must be amended; as written the implementer has no task satisfying the 2-bit clause.
